lisa_billing: Heads-up — Acme Corp (acct: ACME-42) invoice 98721 failed card attempts at 13:05 UTC. Gateway returned AVS/CVV/address mismatch responses. See webhook dump below.

mike_support: Do we have a customer contact? What exact decline codes are we seeing?

lisa_billing: Customer contact is jen@acme.com. Gateway response (redacted): {"status":"declined","decline_code":"avs_failed","cvc_check":"failed","address_line1_check":"failed","failure_message":"AVS/CVV mismatch, cardholder verification failed"} 

sarah_ops: @payments-bot can you pull the full transaction log for merchant_id=rwd-prod-1 tx reference tx_1710849123_01?

payments-bot: Log pulled — tx_id: tx_1710849123_01, status: declined, reason: avs_mismatch, issuer_message: "address verification failed", attempts: 2, last_response_code: 402

nate_engineering: Can someone paste the API request payload we sent (masked card numbers) and the billing address we submitted? Also whether we used tokenization vs raw PAN.

lisa_billing: We sent tokenized card (tok_****4242). Billing payload snippet: {
  "card": {"token": "tok_redwood_abc123"},
  "billing": {"line1": "123 Old Mill Rd", "city": "Cambridge", "state": "MA", "postal_code": "02139", "country": "US"}
}
Note: customer says they recently moved offices, may be using new address in their bank records.

mike_support: Customer says their billing address on file with the bank differs from what they entered on our Portal. They tried twice with same card. Any retry policy for enterprise accounts? @raj_finance

raj_finance: For enterprise contracts we have a 72h retry window (3 attempts). Manual retry by Finance is allowed after verification. We can also accept PO if they prefer. For AVS/CVV failures, issuer often blocks; manual retries sometimes succeed if they update address first. Need documented approval to bypass automated risk checks for a manual charge.

sarah_ops: Recommended customer-facing steps: 1) Confirm billing address exactly as on card statement (line1, postal code). 2) Try alternate card or request a PO. 3) If they insist card is correct, advise contacting issuer — AVS/CVC checks are performed by issuer and may decline if addresses don't match or cardholder verification fails.

nate_engineering: Engineering action items: (a) Surface decline_subcode (avs_line1|postal|cvc) in our webhook & Console rather than generic "card_declined", (b) Add a Console CTA "Retry payment / Update billing address" that pre-fills customer's last billing data, (c) Add logging to correlate gateway decline_code -> our user_facing message for faster triage.

lisa_billing: I've emailed Jen with steps to update billing address and to try an alternate card. Also requested a screenshot of the billing statement to verify address format. If they provide updated address, please hold for manual retry. @raj_finance can you prepare a manual retry when they confirm?

raj_finance: Will do — I need an email confirmation and the updated billing address. I'll log a manual retry request and route to Risk for approval if necessary.

mike_support: Thanks all — I've attached internal ticket #24561 and added notes. Marking escalated to Finance + Eng for mapping and Console changes.

payments-bot: Escalation created: tickets/rwd-payments/24561 (assignee: raj_finance)

lisa_billing: Closing loop — will update thread when Acme confirms address or provides PO.
